name: Events and Seasons
description: Brings back the online game's events: the hub's festival looks, the Super Stew Festival (Kill Coins or Death Metals), the fighter recovery discount, the Chokufunsha sale, seasonal mushrooms all year, the Travis Imposter and WarDogs collab Haters, and the weekly and season quests. Each is set in Configuration. The festival stew needs lid-stewpull.dll, the Stew Multi Pull plugin (Get mods...).
author: KSFA

settings.label: Mushroom Club festival
settings.help: The hub's Mushroom Club in its festival look, as during the online game's stew festivals (the MUSHROOM_FES event). The Super Stew Festival below turns it on by itself.

settings.label: Chokufunsha festival lights
settings.help: The neon lights on the Chokufunsha parts shop, as during the online game's parts shop festivals (CHOKU_FES).

settings.label: TDM festival sign
settings.help: The animated Fort-kun sign in the hub, as during the online game's TDM festivals (TDM_FES).

settings.label: Super Stew Festival
settings.help: A festival stew at the Mushroom Stew shop, with its festival icon: one random decal a pull from the ones you choose below, with the ★★★★ and ★★★★★ ones boosted. It needs lid-stewpull.dll, the Stew Multi Pull plugin (Get mods...) - without it the offline server only offers the first stew, so this one does not show. With the Stew Multi Pull mod its Purchase xN gives no decal twice.

settings.label: Pay with

options.label: Kill Coins
Death Metals (needs the Death Metals mod on)

settings.help: Death Metal stews only show with the Death Metals mod on: its BrgGame.upk patch takes out the offline release's filter that hides them.

settings.label: Price in Kill Coins
settings.help: A pull, when paying with Kill Coins. The normal stew is 50,000.

settings.label: Price in Death Metals
settings.help: A pull, when paying with Death Metals.

settings.label: ★★★★ and ★★★★★ odds
settings.help: How many times their normal stew odds the four- and five-star decals get. 3x is what the online festivals advertised; 1x leaves the odds as they are.

settings.label: Decals in the festival stew
settings.default_label: Every ★★★ and up from the normal stew
settings.default_sql: SELECT o.sklid FROM master_skillgacha_odds o JOIN master_skill s ON s.id = o.sklid WHERE o.id = 'SKLGACH_NORMAL_OFFLINE' AND o.odds > 0 AND s.rarity >= 3
settings.help: Which decals the festival stew can give. The list is every decal in your masters.db, including ones other mods add, so switch those mods on first. Each keeps the odds the normal stew gives it (one it never gives gets the normal odds for its stars), times the boost above for four and five stars.

settings.label: Festival banner and hub flyer
settings.help: The festival's banner in the stew shop and its flyer in the hub. The online game showed a picture from its server in the banner; offline the frame, title and text show without it.

settings.label: Free continues
settings.help: The online game's Free Continue campaigns: how many continues are free each day. 0 is off. The campaigns gave 1, 3 or 4. They are topped up at the game's daily reset (10:00 UTC), so they show from the next reset, not straight away.

settings.label: Fighter recovery discount
settings.help: The online game's recovery discount event: this much off recovering fighters, on top of any Express Pass discount. 0 is off; the event was 50%.

settings.label: Chokufunsha sale weapons
settings.help: The online game's Chokufunsha sale: the Jungle Machete E RG and the Iron Hammer RG in the parts shop.

settings.label: Seasonal mushrooms

options.label: In their own months (as the game does it)
All four seasons, all year
Spring's (Eggshrooms) all year
Summer's (Parasol Shrooms) all year
Autumn's (Pumpkinshrooms) all year
Winter's (Snowcaps) all year

settings.help: The game picks the season from your PC's month: winter in January and February, spring in April and May, summer in July and August, autumn in October and November, and none in the months between. "All year" puts that season's mushrooms in every month instead of the others. "All four" mixes them, each a quarter as common, so seasonal mushrooms overall turn up as often as in a season month. The title screen and hub decorations still follow the month.

settings.label: Collab Haters

options.label: Off
Travis Imposters (No More Heroes)
WarDogs (World of Tanks; needs the Crossover pack)
Both

settings.help: The online collab events' Haters on the Tower's floors, using the game's own event spawn pattern, which also has more Haters about. The WarDogs wear World of Tanks gear the PC release left out; the LET IT DIE Crossover Content pack puts it back, so switch that on first.

settings.label: Quest schedule

options.label: As online: a new week every Monday
options.help: The weekly sets as they ran online, each week the one from that week of the year, and the season quests by their seasons, until January 2033.

options.label: A new draw every few days
options.help: Every period a fresh set of the quests you picked, drawn at random.

options.label: All of them, all the time
options.help: Every quest you picked, always on the board. The first-clear reward comes once; each clear after pays the smaller one.

options.label: Off
options.help: No weekly or season quests, as the game shipped.

settings.help: The online game's weekly and season quests at the quest board. Only the quests ticked in "Quests in the pool" appear, whichever schedule you choose.

settings.label: Days per period
settings.help: For "A new draw every few days": how long each set stays (7 starts them on Mondays, 10:00 UTC). Periods are written up to a year ahead of the day you save (fewer when they hold many quests - about 6,000 quests in all); saving the mod list again later carries them on.

settings.label: Quests per period
settings.help: For "A new draw every few days": how many of the picked quests each period draws (online weeks had 15 or 16).

INSERT OR REPLACE INTO master_mushroom_gen_odds (odds_id, id, msrid, freq) SELECT o.odds_id, s.id, s.msrid, s.freq FROM (SELECT id, msrid, MAX(1, freq / 4) AS freq FROM master_mushroom_gen_odds WHERE (odds_id = 'MUSHROOM_SPRING' AND msrid IN ('MSR_200', 'MSR_201', 'MSR_202')) OR (odds_id = 'MUSHROOM_SUMMER' AND msrid IN ('MSR_306', 'MSR_307', 'MSR_308')) OR (odds_id = 'MUSHROOM_AUTUMN' AND msrid IN ('MSR_309', 'MSR_310', 'MSR_311')) OR (odds_id = 'MUSHROOM_WINTER' AND msrid IN ('MSR_312', 'MSR_313', 'MSR_314'))) s JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT odds_id FROM master_mushroom_gen_odds WHERE odds_id IN ('MUSHROOM_SPRING', 'MUSHROOM_SUMMER', 'MUSHROOM_AUTUMN', 'MUSHROOM_WINTER')) o;
